title: Prophylactic Antibiotics on Urethral Catheter Withdrawal
brief_summary: Urinary-tract infection (UTI) is the most common type of hospital-acquired infection (30% of all). The purpose of this study is to determine whether antibiotic prophylaxis for urinary catheter removal is useful at preventing catheter-associated urinary-tract infection.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Urethral catheter in situ for at least 3 days (72h)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Pregnancy
* Impaired renal or hepatic function (serum creatinine \> 150 mmol/l, serum transaminases \> 75 IU/l)
* Fever
* Symptomatic urinary tract infection
* Antibiotic use ≤ 48 hours before urinary catheter removal
* Allergy to trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole or ciprofloxacin
* Urologic pathology
